official_data.observations: Defines user screen time as time watched divided by actual show duration, then frequency and Top-5. Does not explicitly resolve interrupted visits, concurrent channels, frequency ties, or local users with fewer than five positives. Public/private split is by users, not time. Descriptive field names/older filenames differ from the actual extracted files; actual local schemas remain authoritative for parsing.

official_overview.observations: Confirms MAP@5, exactly five space-delimited IDs, subsequent weeks 31-42, permission to use external data, and a historical 10 submissions/day limit. This is not verification of the current late-submission account quota.

participant_article.author: Nikita Melentev
participant_article.title: Two-layered Recommender System Methodology: A Prize-Winning Solution
participant_article.quote: TV-program was considered watched if the user watched over 80% of it and did not change the channel.
participant_article.ideas_used: Separate target coverage from model-input threshold; test repeat frequency with >50% input coverage; consider combining repeat and collaborative rankings.
participant_article.authority: Participant account, not an official competition rule; official inclusive >=0.8 overrides the article's strict wording.
